transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess for the past year or so, I've just been having some trouble staying on track at work. It's... it doesn't take much. Like a phone buzzing, or somebody walking past my office. Or even just a random thought, like about my in-laws or something. It just pulls me off whatever I’m doing before I can stop it. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?

Yeah... I suppose so. Um. Especially in meetings. I guess I'm usually bouncing my knee or... clicking a pen. Just shifting around in the chair. People have started giving me these looks, like they think I'm trying to rush them. But I'm just... trying to listen.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I have to make quick decisions sometimes for my job, but... I wouldn't say I act without thinking. Not really.
Do you often find yourself making careless mistakes in your daily activities?
I don't... I don't really think so. I mean, I have an assistant who handles a lot of the details, so... I guess I haven't noticed making any major mistakes.
Do you find it hard to focus on tasks during your free time, like hobbies or reading?
Not really. I mean... I don't have much free time to begin with. But if I'm doing something I actually want to do, I don't have an issue with it. I just do it.
Did you have trouble paying attention or sitting still when you were a kid?

I guess so... yeah. I mean, teachers were always moving my seat. Said I talked too much or... got up when I wasn't supposed to. Sometimes I'd just answer before they even finished asking the question. But... it was just kid stuff, you know?
Were you often described as restless or having excess energy when you were a child?
I don't really know. Maybe? I wasn't exactly paying attention to what people called me back then. I was just... a kid.
Did you have any problems with attention or behavior that caused difficulties for you in school?
I don't know if I'd call it difficulties. I mean, I didn't finish high school, but... that's just how it goes sometimes. I was busy, had other things going on. School just wasn't really my thing.
As a child, did you often interrupt others or blurt out answers before you were called upon?
I mean... like I said a minute ago, yeah. Sometimes. I don't really know about 'often,' though. I wasn't exactly keeping track of it.
Have you continued to have trouble sustaining focus on tasks or activities as an adult?

Yeah, I guess. I mean, at work... if I sit down with one of my managers or try to start a planning document, I'll be locked in for the first few minutes. But then... I don't know. I'll realize I kind of missed half of what was said. I just have to ask them to run it back.
Do you often feel excessively fidgety or restless when you're not at work?

I mean... maybe a little. If I'm supposed to just sit still for a while. Like... at a family dinner, or... I go to these church volunteer meetings sometimes. I don't know, it just feels like... like there's a motor running in me, I guess. I just end up needing to move or do something with my hands. But it's not a big deal.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and restlessness your entire life?

I guess so. Looking back... it was kind of like that when I was a kid, too. I remember teachers always moving my seat. They said I talked too much, or I'd get up without asking. And, you know, I guess I did blurt things out before they finished asking a question. But... yeah, it's been a while.
Have these difficulties with focus and restlessness caused you significant distress or problems in your daily life?

I mean... I'm still keeping up overall. It's not like everything is falling apart. But... I guess it causes some friction. 

People at work get a little impatient with me sometimes... like during meetings, or if I'm trying to have a mentoring conversation with one of my managers. And at home... it's starting to cost me some trust, I think. Just when family plans don't go the way they should because I missed something. But... yeah. I'm managing.
Have you experienced significant periods of time where these focus and restlessness difficulties were not a problem for you?

I mean... it's always been there, I guess. But it wasn't always this much of an issue. 

It's just... it's been noticeably harder to manage for about a year and two months now. There's just... some conflict with my in-laws. It's kind of taking over a lot of our family life lately, so... yeah. It's been worse since that started.
Would you say these difficulties with focus and restlessness are currently causing you mild, moderate, or severe problems in your daily life?
Probably just... mild, I guess. Like I said before, I'm still keeping up with things. It's not ruining everything or anything like that. Just... mild.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and restlessness for more than 6 months?
Yeah... like I mentioned before, it's been... about a year and two months now that it's been this noticeable. Ever since that stuff with my in-laws started up. So... yes, more than six months.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety at home, not just at work?

Yeah, I guess so. It's... it's not just work. Like, if we're having a family dinner, or... I help out with some volunteer meetings at church. When I'm just supposed to sit there, it's hard. It just feels like... I don't know, like there's a motor running inside me. I just end up needing to move around or... find something to do with my hands.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety in quiet activities at home?

Yeah, I suppose so. Um... like, if I try to just sit quietly with my wife at night, or... I tried meditating once. It's just hard. I end up getting up to clear the dishes, or... checking my phone. Or I just start talking because... I don't know, the quiet just sort of gets under my skin.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and restlessness in multiple settings, such as at home, at work, and in social situations?

Yeah... I suppose so. I mean, I'm still keeping up with everything overall. But... it is starting to cause some issues. 

Like... I can tell I'm losing some trust at home when family plans don't go the way they should. And at work... people are starting to lose patience with me during meetings, or... when I'm trying to have mentoring conversations. So, yeah... it's in a few different places.
Have these difficulties with focus and restlessness significantly impacted your ability to perform your job or maintain relationships?

Like I just mentioned... yeah. I mean, I still get things done overall. But... it's definitely costing me. 

When I derail a meeting or mess up a family plan... people lose patience. My team at work, my family... the trust just takes a hit. So... yes. It does.
